description: This file defines the ContractService class, which provides business logic for handling contracts, including printing, approval workflows, and database interactions within a Spring-based Java application.

classes.name: ContractService
classes.description: A service class managing contract operations such as printing, approval, and retrieval, integrating with repositories and other services.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Uses PdfService to print the given Contract as a PDF document.

methods.name: sendToSupervisor
methods.description: Traverses the supervisor chain to find an appropriate supervisor who can accept the contract based on its value.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Marks the contract as accepted if the currently authenticated user is authorized to do so.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a contract by its unique identifier.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the given contract to the database.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves all contracts associated with a specific client.

methods.name: findByAcceptedBy
methods.description: Retrieves all contracts accepted by a specific user.
